title: Pending Withdrawal Queued Until Trade Close
precondition: Sub-account configured with 'Queue Withdrawals Until Zero Positions' policy.
steps: 1. Investor requests withdrawal while trade active.
expected_result: Request registered as 'Pending_Trade_Close'; automatically executed the moment manager closes all positions.
actual_result: Policy queues withdrawal request with status 'Pending_Trade_Close', auto-executing once zero positions remain open.
